name: F Troop
description: F Troop is a satirical American television sitcom that originally aired for two seasons on ABC-TV. It debuted in the United States on September 14, 1965 and concluded its run on April 6, 1967 with a total of 65 episodes. The first season of 34 episodes was filmed in black-and-white, but the show switched to color for its second season.

videos.title: Fall in With F TROOP
videos.overview:
28 minute “Fall in with F Troop” which interviews Mike Teilmann (Executive director of the Bob Hope Hollywood USO at LAX), associate producer and director Phil Rawlins, writers Rocky

and Irma Kalish, CW4 Howard Dyk, USAR (Ret. – Commander, Blue Devils Horse Platoon), Maj. Mark Gillespie USA (Ret. – Former professor of history – West Point), Ken Berry, Marilyn Tucker (Forrest Tucker’s wife and she also acted on the show) and an audio contribution from Joe Brooks (“Trooper Vanderbilt”).  Sadly, they still don’t interview Larry Storch.

videos.title: Scourge of the West
videos.overview: Private Wilton Parmenter gets promoted after leading a charge against the Confederates and receives an assignment as Fort Courage's new commanding officer.

videos.title: Don't Look Now, One of Our Cannon Is Missing
videos.overview: O'Rourke plots to retrieve the cannon he loaned to the Hekawis for use in a festival.

videos.title: The Phantom Major
videos.overview: A British Major shows the men the advantages of using camouflage to fight Indians.

videos.title: Corporal Agarn's Farewell to the Troops
videos.overview: Agarn believes he is dying after his medical report is mixed up with that of his horse.

videos.title: The Return of Bald Eagle
videos.overview: A renegade Indian tries to go straight but finds he can't.

videos.title: Dirge for the Scourge
videos.overview: Sam Urp, scourge of the west, comes to Fort Courage for a showdown with Parmenter, the Scourge of the West.

videos.title: The Girl From Philadelphia
videos.overview: Wilton's old girlfriend comes to vie for his affection and to persuade him to return to the East.

videos.title: Old Iron Pants
videos.overview: O'Rourke Enterprise's tries mail order brides while Parmenter is away at command school.

videos.title: Me Heap Big Injun
videos.overview: Agarn leaves the troop to become an Indian, and turns out to be a better Indian than the entire Hekawi tribe.

videos.title: She's Only a Build in a Girdled Cage
videos.overview: Dobbs' mother is coming but everyone thinks it is Laura Lee, a dance hall singer to entertain the men.

videos.title: A Gift From the Chief
videos.overview: Parmenter accidentally saves Wild Eagle's life, and receives a baby as a reward.

videos.title: Honest Injun
videos.overview: A con man muscles his way into O'Rourke Enterprises by selling worthless land as potential gold mines.

videos.title: O'Rourke vs. O'Reilly
videos.overview: A beautiful woman almost drives O'Rourke Enterprises out of business when she opens a saloon across the street.

videos.title: The 86 Proof Spring
videos.overview: Parmenter searches for the Hekawis' whiskey supply, unaware that it is hidden at Fort Courage.

videos.title: Here Comes the Tribe
videos.overview: The Chief's daughter is kidnapped by a brave from another tribe looking for a wife, and the troop comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Iron Horse Go Home
videos.overview: The Hekawis sell their land to the railroad and move into Fort Courage.

videos.title: Our Hero, What's His Name?
videos.overview: Agarn boasts to a girl he's trying to impress that he killed Geronimo, so Geronimo comes after Agarn.

videos.title: Wrongo Starr and the Lady in Black
videos.overview: A famous jinx comes to town and meets a widow whose four husbands have all died mysteriously.

videos.title: El Diablo
videos.overview: Agarn's look-a-like Mexican bandit cousin comes to town, and the Corporal must capture him to clear his name.

videos.title: Go For Broke
videos.overview: Jane's cousin, an inventor, helps Parmenter win a poker game to replace the pension funds lost by O'Rourke.

videos.title: The New I.G.
videos.overview: The new Inspector General plots to wipe out the Hekawis with a rifle he has invented.

videos.title: Spy, Counterspy, Counter Counterspy
videos.overview: Agarn is chosen to test a bullet proof vest, but it is stolen when Fort Courage in infiltrated by spies.

videos.title: The Courtship of Wrangler Jane
videos.overview: O'Rourke, figuring his operations will be more profitable with Wilton away, plays cupid for Wilton and Jane.

videos.title: Play, Gypsy, Play
videos.overview: Gypsies come and invade Fort Courage.

videos.title: Reunion for O'Rourke
videos.overview: Agarn arranges a celebration of O'Rourke's 25 years of service in the Army.

videos.title: Captain Parmenter, One Man Army
videos.overview: The men learn that they are not legally enlisted so they leave and Wilton is forced to man the fort alone.

videos.title: Don't Ever Speak to Me Again
videos.overview: Just before the troop is to be cited for high morale, a fight breaks out.

videos.title: Too Many Cooks Spoil the Troop
videos.overview: O'Rourke adds things to the cook's food list in order to pad his pockets.

videos.title: Indian Fever
videos.overview: Agarn thinks he is crazy when he is the only one to see an Indian.

videos.title: Johnny Eagle Eye
videos.overview: O'Rourke expects to make money on a young Indian scout in the cavalry sharpshooting contest.

videos.title: A Fort's Best Friend is Not a Mother
videos.overview: Wilton's mother comes to visit and tries to tell him how to run the fort.

videos.title: Lieutenant O'Rourke, Front and Center
videos.overview: O'Rourke enterprises is in trouble when O'Rourke gets promoted to officer.

videos.title: The Day the Indians Won
videos.overview: The peaceable Hekawis are ordered to go on the warpath by the Council of Indian Nations.

videos.title: Will the Real Captain Try to Stand Up?
videos.overview: The town drunk poses as Captain to impress his visiting daughter.

videos.title: The Singing Mountie
videos.overview: A mountie is after the burglar of Banff, whom he believes is Agarn's look-a-like French Canadian cousin, Lucky Pierre Agarniere.

videos.title: How to be F Troop Without Really Trying
videos.overview: Everyone except Agarn is transferred, and he must train G Troop whose recruits turn out to be worse than F Troop.

videos.title: Bye, Bye, Balloon
videos.overview: A Prussian balloonist comes to the Fort to inspect prospective personnel.

videos.title: Reach for the Sky, Pardner
videos.overview: The bank wants to repossess the saloon when O'Rourke's payroll is stolen, so Agarn and O'Rourke volunteer to guard the next one.

videos.title: The Great Troop Robbery
videos.overview: A phony medicine man tries to blame his thefts on Agarn when Agarn suffers a temporary memory loss.

videos.title: The West Goes Ghost
videos.overview: O'Rourke Enterprises takes over a haunted ghost town, expecting to get rich when the railroad comes through.

videos.title: Yellow Bird
videos.overview: The daughter of a mining tycoon, kidnapped and raised by Indians, takes a liking to Wilton.

videos.title: The Ballot of Corporal Agarn
videos.overview: Agarn is to cast the deciding absentee vote in a hometown election.

videos.title: Did Your Father Come from Ireland?
videos.overview: O'Rourke's visiting father turns the town into Little Ireland while the Sergeant is on vacation.

videos.title: For Whom the Bugle Tolls
videos.overview: O'Rourke needs to distract a visiting colonel who enjoys bugle calls, but the trouble is that Dobbs is the army's worst bugler.

videos.title: Miss Parmenter
videos.overview: Wilton's husband-hunting sister goes after Dobbs, and also assists in Wild Eagle's appendectomy.

videos.title: La Dolce Courage
videos.overview: An Italian suitor challenges Agarn when Agarn goes after his beloved.

videos.title: Wilton the Kid
videos.overview: Capt. Parmenter's evil twin Kid Vicious has been robbing banks.

videos.title: The Return of Wrongo Starr
videos.overview: Wrongo gets mixed up with a goat and some dynamite when Parmenter assigns him as a guard.

videos.title: Survival of the Fittest
videos.overview: Parmenter and Agarn go on a wilderness survival test with only a knife, a canteen, and the new Army survival manual.

videos.title: Bring on the Dancing Girls
videos.overview: O'Rourke tries to get even with a blackmailer who took over the saloon.

videos.title: The Loco Brothers
videos.overview: Two renegade Indians trap Parmenter and hold him hostage, but just want some company.

videos.title: From Karate with Love
videos.overview: A samurai is looking for a Japanese girl.

videos.title: The Sergeant and the Kid
videos.overview: O'Rourke must talk a runaway 10-year-old boy out of joining the cavalry.

videos.title: What Are You Doing after the Massacre?
videos.overview: A 147-year-old Indian comes back to take over all of America, and begins by trying to starve the troop into surrender.

videos.title: A Horse of Another Color
videos.overview: Wilton wants to capture a wild stallion to impress Wrangler Jane, but O'Rourke wants to sell it to the circus..

videos.title: V is for Vampire
videos.overview: A Transylvanian Count that everyone thinks is a vampire is believed responsible for the disappearance of Wrangler Jane.

videos.title: That's Show Biz
videos.overview: Agarn leaves to manage a rock group called the Bedbugs, which is somewhat ahead of its time.

videos.title: The Day They Shot Agarn
videos.overview: Agarn faces a firing squad after everyone believes he killed Sgt. O'Rourke.

videos.title: Only One Russian is Coming! Only One Russian is Coming!
videos.overview: Agarn's look-a-like Russian Cossack cousin, Dmitri Agarnoff, comes to town and falls for Wrangler Jane, making Wilton jealous.

videos.title: Guns, Guns, Who's Got the Guns?
videos.overview: Parmenter goes undercover to find out who is selling guns to the Apaches after a colonel lets him know that someone in F Troop is a traitor.

videos.title: Marriage, Fort Courage Style
videos.overview: Their dreams of what could happen make Agarn and O'Rourke anxious to rescue Parmenter from a marriage broker.

videos.title: Carpetbagging, Anyone?
videos.overview: F Troop faces eviction when a rich carpetbagger comes to town, so they stage an Indian raid to prove they're still needed.

videos.title: The Majority of Wilton
videos.overview: When Parmenter catches a cold the day before his examination for promotion to major, his friends rush to his bedside with their homespun remedies.

videos.title: Our Brave in F Troop
videos.overview: Wild Eagle has a toothache, so O'Rourke sneaks him into the Fort to see a visiting dentist, where he has to pretend to be a member of the troop when he attracts the attention of a visiting general.

videos.title: Is This Fort Really Necessary?
videos.overview: An efficiency expert comes to Fort Courage, with the authority to close it down.
